instruction: I want to enable screen lock on suspend so my computer is secured when I close the lid. Can you help me configure this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling screen lock on suspend. Evaluator verifies the ubuntu-lock-on-suspend setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.screensaver ubuntu-lock-on-suspend' to check the exact setting required by the instruction
Metric (exact_match) appropriately compares the command output with expected value 'true\n' using strict equality
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct and includes proper formatting (newline character) matching gsettings output format
Complete coverage: Single-step task with single verification point checking the exact GNOME setting that controls screen lock on suspend
No postconfig needed: gsettings values can be queried at any time without requiring UI state or dialogs to be open
Data flow is correct: vm_command_line getter returns string output, exact_match metric compares strings, expected value is in correct format
